The '''Geal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Narn Detan]] were re-establishing the government of a colony in the system when they encountered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Moxin Tark]]. Tark killed Detan, escaped, and claimed the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Captain's head.
